Bug_Explanation: The bug occurs when an array is passed as a single varargs argument, where the array type is not exactly the type of array that the varargs method expects. In this case, a String array is passed to a method expecting Object varargs, which leads to confusion whether an array of String should be treated as a single object or as individual elements for the varargs method. Similarly, passing null to a varargs method can lead to confusion whether the method should receive a null array or an array with a single null element.

In showBug1, a String array is passed to a method expecting Object varargs, which leads to ambiguity whether the method should treat it as a single object or as individual elements. In showBug2, passing null to the varargs method causes confusion whether it represents a null array or an array with a single null element.
